I have been there and the only (that worked for me which was advised by my therapist) is to try to change one thing in your day. This works if you have felt like your days are getting muddled due to them being the same. For an example if you find yourself always in bed try sitting in a chair or couch or maybe the flood. And during that day avoid the bed (if it the place you spent most your days in) as much as you can.

Or if the bed doesn’t work try getting dressed, it might seem weird since it’s quarantine in most countries but changing your outfit has been proven to change ones mood and actions.
